services.name: Collage Night
services.desc: Strathcona County Museum & Archives, 913 Ash St, Sherwood Park, AB T8A 2G3, Canada Join local artist Andrea Krahn for an evening of painting at Strathma. Andrea will lead the group through the featured painting, and you’ll head home with your finished piece at the end of the night. Tickets are $35 per person and include painting supplies and one drink. No painting experience is needed, but advance tickets are required. services.desc: From weekly family programs and monthly creative nights to walking tours, exhibit related activities, and community celebrations, there's always something happening at Strathma Join us every Saturday for hands on activities inspired by local history, exhibits, collections, and seasonal themes. Activities change throughout the year and may pause or shift when a special event is taking place. Get creative and make something uniquely yours! Create your own collage using vintage magazines, newspapers, ephemera, and more. Join us once a month for a relaxed evening of creativity and conversation. All ages welcome! services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Bring learning to life with a museum field trip! We offer engaging, curriculum-connected programs for grades 1-6. Our themes and programs are aligned with the 2026 Alberta curriculum and are reviewed and updated annually to ensure they remain relevant and support classroom learning. To book a field trip or learn more about our educational programs, please contact Keirsten at education@strathma.ca. Students will explore nature, place, roles, and responsibilities in Strathcona County’s past, and learn how communities like Beaver Hills worked together to live, grow, and thrive.
